title: Mathematical Foundations for Advanced Computer Vision
subtitle: Matrix Calculus, Lie Groups, and Optimization Manifolds
description: Rigorous mathematical foundation required for modern deep visual perception, projective geometry, and non-convex optimization. Transitions from scalar calculus and basic matrices to tensor calculus, matrix manifolds, and Lie groups.

mathCompetencies: Matrix calculus & trace derivatives (d/dW Tr(A W B))
Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) and low-rank approximation
Multivariate Gaussian distributions and Mahalanobis distance
Constrained convex optimization & Karush-Kuhn-Tucker (KKT) conditions
Lie groups SO(3), SE(3) and Lie algebra so(3), se(3)

learningObjectives: Derive analytical matrix derivatives and tensor Jacobians for deep learning autograd graphs.
Formulate low-rank matrix factorizations and spectral decomposition for image structure analysis.
Model spatial transformations using Lie group SO(3) rotations and SE(3) rigid body motions without gimbal lock.
Solve constrained optimization problems using Lagrange multipliers, KKT conditions, and Gauss-Newton solvers.

topics.title: Matrix Calculus & Tensor Derivatives in Vision
topics.mathematicalFocus: Matrix trace calculus, Jacobians, Hessians, and backpropagation mechanics through arbitrary matrix transformations.

topics.title: Singular Value Decomposition & Spectral Geometry
topics.mathematicalFocus: Thin SVD, Eckart-Young-Mirsky low-rank theorem, Principal Component Analysis, and Covariance ellipsoids.

topics.title: Probability, Multivariate Gaussians & Information Theory
topics.mathematicalFocus: Multivariate normal distributions, Mahalanobis distance, KL divergence, Jensen-Shannon divergence, and InfoNCE mutual information lower bounds.

topics.title: Non-Convex Optimization & Numerical Solvers
topics.mathematicalFocus: Gradient descent variants, Gauss-Newton, Levenberg-Marquardt, saddle-point dynamics, and KKT conditions.

topics.title: Lie Groups & Lie Algebras for Spatial Vision
topics.mathematicalFocus: SO(3) and SE(3) manifolds, exponential and logarithmic maps, Rodrigues formula, and perturbation models for visual odometry.

title: Advanced Digital Image Processing & Mathematical Inverse Problems
subtitle: Variational Methods, Total Variation Regularization, and ADMM
description: Formulation of image restoration, deblurring, super-resolution, and reconstruction as ill-posed mathematical inverse problems. Covers variational regularization, Total Variation, and split optimization algorithms.

mathCompetencies: 2D Continuous & Discrete Fourier Transform properties
Variational calculus and Euler-Lagrange equations
Total Variation (TV) functional minimization
Tikhonov regularization and ill-posed inverse problems
Split Bregman and Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers (ADMM)

learningObjectives: Formulate image restoration tasks as ill-posed linear inverse problems y = Ax + n.
Derive the Euler-Lagrange equations for Total Variation (Rudin-Osher-Fatemi) edge-preserving denoising.
Implement the Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers (ADMM) to decouple non-smooth L1 regularization.
Analyze frequency-domain point spread functions (PSF) and Wiener/Richardson-Lucy deconvolution.

topics.title: Ill-Posed Inverse Problems in Visual Sensing
topics.mathematicalFocus: Forward modeling (y = Ax + n), condition numbers, Fredholm integral equations, and Hadamard ill-posedness.

topics.title: Variational Energy Minimization & Total Variation
topics.mathematicalFocus: Euler-Lagrange equations, Dirichlet energy vs Total Variation norm, Rudin-Osher-Fatemi (ROF) model.

topics.title: Split Optimization: ADMM & Split Bregman
topics.mathematicalFocus: Augmented Lagrangian methods, dual ascent, variable splitting, and proximal operators (soft thresholding).

topics.title: Blind & Non-Blind Motion Deconvolution
topics.mathematicalFocus: Point Spread Function (PSF) estimation, Wiener deconvolution, Richardson-Lucy algorithm, and kernel priors.

topics.title: Modern Learned Image Reconstruction
topics.mathematicalFocus: Deep unfolding networks, plug-and-play ADMM priors with neural denoisers, and implicit regularization.

benchmarks: Levin et al. Motion Deblurring Dataset

title: Robust Visual Tracking & Multi-Object Tracking Systems
subtitle: State-Space Modeling, Bipartite Association, and Motion Fusion
description: Comprehensive theory and algorithmic architecture for visual tracking in dynamic scenes. Covers state estimation with Kalman/EKF/UKF, bipartite data association, metric appearance embeddings, and occlusion recovery.

mathCompetencies: Linear state-space models and Gaussian process transitions
Kalman Filter mathematical derivation (predict and update steps)
Extended Kalman Filter (EKF) and Unscented Kalman Filter (UKF)
Combinatorial optimization: Hungarian algorithm & Jonker-Volgenant solver
Deep metric learning losses (Triplet loss, Cosine margin)
programmingCompetencies: PyTorch feature extraction and cosine distance computation

learningObjectives: Derive the optimal Kalman gain from Bayesian minimum mean square error principles.
Implement bipartite matching between track state predictions and multi-scale object detections.
Analyze modern tracking frameworks: SORT, DeepSORT, ByteTrack, and BoT-SORT.
Evaluate tracking performance using HOTA, MOTA, IDF1, and identity-switch diagnostic metrics.

topics.title: Bayesian Filtering & State-Space Kinematics
topics.mathematicalFocus: Kalman filter Riccati equations, process vs measurement noise covariance (Q, R), and non-linear kinematics (EKF/UKF).

topics.title: Bipartite Data Association & Matching Optimization
topics.mathematicalFocus: Cost matrices (IoU, Mahalanobis, ReID cosine distance), Hungarian algorithm, and greedy matching heuristics.

topics.title: Modern MOT Architectures: ByteTrack & BoT-SORT
topics.mathematicalFocus: Low-confidence detection association (ByteTrack), camera motion compensation (CMC), and global link graphs.

topics.title: Transformer-Based Tracking & Track-by-Query
topics.mathematicalFocus: TrackFormer and MOTR: spatial-temporal cross-attention, query lifetimes, and end-to-end multi-object tracking.

topics.title: HOTA & Evaluation Metrics Standardization
topics.mathematicalFocus: Higher Order Tracking Accuracy (HOTA) mathematical decomposition into DetA and AssA; IDF1 and MOTA diagnostics.

interactiveLab.title: Synthetic MOT Arena & Bipartite Association Lab

title: Advanced Deep Visual Recognition & Attention Mechanisms
subtitle: Deformable Attention, Bipartite Matching Loss, and Transformer Detectors
description: Exploration of modern state-of-the-art visual recognition architectures. Focuses on deformable self-attention, end-to-end transformer detection (DETR), set prediction loss, and multi-scale feature pyramids.

mathCompetencies: Scaled dot-product attention algebra & Softmax gradient dynamics
Bipartite matching loss and Hungarian set assignment
Deformable attention multi-scale sampling formulation
Focal Loss and Generalized Focal Loss for continuous label distributions
Bounding box regression metrics: IoU, GIoU, DIoU, CIoU
programmingCompetencies: PyTorch custom autograd and custom Module authoring
Torchvision backbones and feature extraction hooks

learningObjectives: Formulate end-to-end object detection as direct set prediction without handcrafted anchors or NMS.
Derive Deformable Attention sampling offsets and bilinear interpolation gradients.
Analyze the convergence dynamics of Hungarian bipartite matching loss in transformer detectors.
Evaluate modern multi-scale detectors on MS COCO across AP, AP50, AP75, and scale-specific subsets.

topics.title: Vision Transformers: Scaled Dot-Product to Deformable Attention
topics.mathematicalFocus: Computational complexity O(N^2) vs O(N K), sparse deformable sampling points, and multi-head attention.

topics.title: End-to-End Object Detection with Transformers (DETR)
topics.mathematicalFocus: Hungarian bipartite matching loss, object query embeddings, and permutation-invariant set prediction.

topics.title: Deformable DETR & Multi-Scale Feature Pyramids
topics.mathematicalFocus: Multi-scale deformable attention modules, reference points, and fast-converging cross-attention.

topics.title: Advanced Classification & Bounding Box Loss Formulations
topics.mathematicalFocus: Focal Loss, Generalized Focal Loss, Quality Focal Loss, GIoU, DIoU, and CIoU gradient dynamics.

topics.title: Modern Single-Stage CNN-Transformer Hybrids
topics.mathematicalFocus: YOLOv8/v9/v10 architectural evolutions, Dual-Label Assignment, and anchor-free regression heads.

title: Multi-View Geometry & 3D Computer Vision
subtitle: Epipolar Geometry, Bundle Adjustment, and Spatial Triangulation
description: Rigorous treatment of geometric computer vision across multiple views. Derives epipolar geometry, the Fundamental and Essential matrices, 3D triangulation, bundle adjustment, and structure-from-motion (SfM).

mathCompetencies: Projective space P^2 and P^3 homogeneous coordinate algebra
Epipolar geometry: Essential matrix (E) and Fundamental matrix (F)
Normalized 8-point and 7-point algorithms
Sampson first-order geometric error approximation
Non-linear least squares bundle adjustment with Levenberg-Marquardt
programmingCompetencies: Open3D / Trimesh point cloud rendering and manipulation

learningObjectives: Derive the epipolar constraint x'^T F x = 0 and camera baseline geometry.
Implement the Hartley-normalized 8-point algorithm for stable fundamental matrix estimation.
Formulate bundle adjustment as a sparse non-linear least squares problem minimizing reprojection error.
Reconstruct sparse 3D point clouds from calibrated multi-view camera sequences.

topics.title: Projective Geometry & Camera Calibration
topics.mathematicalFocus: Pinhole camera matrix P = K [R|t], intrinsic matrix K, radial distortion models, and camera resectioning.

topics.title: Two-View Epipolar Geometry & Essential Matrix
topics.mathematicalFocus: Epipoles, epipolar lines, Essential matrix E = [t]_x R, singular value properties, and pose recovery.

topics.title: The Fundamental Matrix & Robust Estimation
topics.mathematicalFocus: Uncalibrated cameras, normalized 8-point algorithm, algebraic vs Sampson error, and RANSAC epipolar fitting.

topics.title: 3D Triangulation & Structure-from-Motion (SfM)
topics.mathematicalFocus: Linear triangulation (DLT), iterative reconstruction pipelines, track building, and incremental SfM.

topics.title: Bundle Adjustment & Levenberg-Marquardt
topics.mathematicalFocus: Reprojection error minimization, sparse Schur complement trick, and camera-point joint optimization.

title: Robust Visual Perception in Adverse Conditions
subtitle: Atmospheric Scattering, Low-Light Enhancement, and Uncertainty Calibration
description: Physical sensor modeling and neural robustness under environmental degradation. Focuses on tropical rain, heavy fog, solar glare, nighttime imaging, and model uncertainty calibration (ECE/OOD).

mathCompetencies: Koschmieder atmospheric radiative transfer equation (I = J*t + A*(1-t))
Dark Channel Prior mathematical formulation and transmission map estimation
Retinex illumination-reflectance decomposition (S = R * L)
Expected Calibration Error (ECE) and Platt temperature scaling
Out-of-Distribution (OOD) detection via Mahalanobis feature distance
programmingCompetencies: OpenCV Dark Channel Prior & Retinex implementations

learningObjectives: Model atmospheric attenuation using Koschmieder's physical radiative transfer law.
Implement zero-reference curve estimation (Zero-DCE) for dynamic range expansion in extreme low light.
Measure neural network overconfidence using Expected Calibration Error (ECE) and Brier scores.
Benchmark model degradation across 15 standard synthetic corruptions using Mean Corruption Error (mCE).

topics.title: Physics of Light in Scattering Media
topics.mathematicalFocus: Koschmieder law, single scattering albedo, transmission map estimation, and atmospheric light vector determination.

topics.title: Dark Channel Prior & Variational Dehazing
topics.mathematicalFocus: He et al. Dark Channel formulation, soft matting, guided filter transmission refinement, and color fidelity preservation.

topics.title: Low-Light Enhancement & Retinex Theory
topics.mathematicalFocus: Illumination map estimation, Zero-DCE quadratic curve optimization without paired ground truth, and noise amplification control.

topics.title: Neural Model Calibration & Uncertainty Estimation
topics.mathematicalFocus: Overconfidence in deep networks, temperature scaling, Expected Calibration Error (ECE), reliability diagrams, and Brier score.

topics.title: Out-of-Distribution Detection & Robustness Auditing
topics.mathematicalFocus: Mahalanobis distance on penultimate layer activations, energy-based OOD scores, and ImageNet-C/COCO-C benchmark suites.

benchmarks: Dark Zurich / NightOwls Adverse Nighttime Datasets

title: Vision Foundation Models & Parameter-Efficient Adaptation
subtitle: Contrastive Representation Learning, LoRA, and Open-Vocabulary Grounding
description: Pretrained visual foundation models and their efficient downstream adaptation. Covers self-supervised visual representation learning (MAE, SimCLR, DINO), contrastive vision-language pretraining (CLIP), and parameter-efficient fine-tuning (LoRA, Adapter layers).

mathCompetencies: Contrastive InfoNCE loss derivation and mutual information bounds
Low-Rank matrix decomposition (W = W_0 + B A, rank r << d)
Attention prefix tuning and cross-modal token projection
High-dimensional cosine metric retrieval spaces

learningObjectives: Derive the InfoNCE loss function and explain how contrastive learning aligns visual and textual token spaces.
Implement Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) for vision transformer attention projection layers.
Evaluate zero-shot transfer capabilities across unseen classes and open-vocabulary detection queries.
Analyze self-supervised visual features produced by DINOv2 for dense semantic correspondences.

topics.mathematicalFocus: Masked Autoencoders (MAE), DINO self-distillation without labels, patch tokens, and semantic feature clustering.

topics.title: Contrastive Vision-Language Learning (CLIP)

topics.title: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT)
topics.mathematicalFocus: LoRA rank decomposition, gradient flow through frozen backbones, adapter layers, and prefix token tuning.

topics.title: Open-Vocabulary Object Detection & Grounding

title: Efficient Computer Vision & Edge AI Architecture
subtitle: Quantization Arithmetic, Neural Pruning, and Latency Optimization
description: Techniques for deploying high-capacity visual perception models on power-constrained, resource-limited edge hardware. Covers uniform affine quantization (INT8/INT4), Quantization-Aware Training (QAT), structured pruning, and memory bandwidth optimization.

mathCompetencies: Uniform affine quantization arithmetic (q = round(x/S) + Z)
Straight-Through Estimator (STE) gradient approximation in QAT
L0, L1, and structured group Lasso pruning formulations
Knowledge Distillation Kullback-Leibler divergence matching
Roofline operational intensity model (FLOPs / Byte memory bandwidth)
programmingCompetencies: ONNX model export, optimization, and ONNX Runtime execution

learningObjectives: Implement symmetric and asymmetric uniform integer quantization (INT8) for convolutional and linear layers.
Formulate Quantization-Aware Training with Straight-Through Estimators to preserve accuracy under low bit-width.
Apply structured channel pruning to eliminate FLOPs while preserving dense memory access patterns.
Profile latency bottlenecks using the Roofline model to balance compute-bound vs memory-bandwidth-bound operations.

topics.title: Quantization Theory & Fixed-Point Arithmetic
topics.mathematicalFocus: Scale factor S, zero-point Z, clipping thresholds, dynamic vs static range calibration, and integer matrix multiplication.

topics.title: Quantization-Aware Training (QAT)
topics.mathematicalFocus: Straight-Through Estimator (STE), learned step size quantization (LSQ), and mixed-precision bit allocation.

topics.title: Structured & Unstructured Neural Pruning
topics.mathematicalFocus: Magnitude pruning, Taylor-expansion sensitivity criteria, structured channel removal, and fine-tuning recovery.

topics.title: Knowledge Distillation for Vision Models
topics.mathematicalFocus: Dark knowledge transfer, temperature-softened cross-entropy, feature-map hint loss, and attention transfer.

topics.title: Hardware Acceleration & Roofline Profiling
topics.mathematicalFocus: Roofline model analysis, SRAM cache hierarchies, memory bandwidth saturation, and ONNX/WebGPU runtime optimization.
